# Kermit Floor

> Kermit Floor is a manufacturer of SPC (stone polymer composite) flooring, wall panels, and skirting boards for residential and commercial interiors. Its combined annual production capacity for SPC flooring and wall panels is 8 million m². Kermit Floor operates in Türkiye, Moldova, Romania and the USA, with its headquarters and main factory in Çayırova, Kocaeli, Türkiye, an additional factory in Chișinău, Moldova and a store in Bucharest, Romania. Contact the sales team for U.S. supply enquiries. The site supports English (no prefix), Turkish (/tr), Bulgarian (/bg), Serbian (/sr), Arabic (/ar) and Ukrainian (/ukr). Product and collection names remain unchanged in the additional languages.

## Manufacturing & Wholesale Supply

- [Manufacturer Profile](https://kermitfloor.com/about): Annual capacity, operating countries, factory locations and wholesale terms. Capacity is the combined flooring and wall-panel total; it is not a separate figure for each product line.
- [Türkçe Üretici Profili](https://kermitfloor.com/tr/hakkimizda): SPC parke ve duvar panelinde yıllık toplam 8 milyon m² kapasite; Türkiye, Moldova, Romanya ve ABD'de faaliyet.
- [OEM & Private-Label SPC Flooring](https://kermitfloor.com/blog/oem-private-label-spc-flooring): OEM/private label is available. Wholesale SPC flooring minimum order is one container; standard lead time is four weeks. Specifications, branding scope, loading and destination delivery timing are confirmed in the quotation.
- [Manufacturer Selection Checklist](https://kermitfloor.com/blog/spc-flooring-manufacturer-turkey-buyers-checklist): Factory identity, product documents, samples and supply terms for comparing manufacturers.
- [Samples & Wholesale Quotations](https://kermitfloor.com/blog/spc-flooring-samples-wholesale-quote): Information to prepare for a sample or quotation request.

## Product Collections: SPC Flooring

- [Elite SPC Flooring Collection](https://kermitfloor.com/spc-flooring-elite-collection): Quick-ship premium SPC flooring decors
- [Elegance SPC Flooring Collection](https://kermitfloor.com/spc-flooring-elegance-collection): Refined SPC flooring decors for modern interiors
- [Sky SPC Flooring Collection](https://kermitfloor.com/spc-flooring-sky-collection): Versatile decors for residential and commercial projects
- [Mosaic SPC Flooring Collection](https://kermitfloor.com/spc-flooring-mosaic-collection): Patterned, stone-inspired SPC flooring designs
- [Travertine SPC Flooring Collection](https://kermitfloor.com/spc-flooring-travertine-collection): Travertine-inspired SPC flooring
- [Natural SPC Parquet Collection](https://kermitfloor.com/spc-parquet-natural-collection): Best-selling natural oak SPC planks
- [Stone SPC Parquet Collection](https://kermitfloor.com/spc-parquet-stone-collection): Stone- and marble-look SPC flooring
- [Full Natural Collection](https://kermitfloor.com/full-natural-collection): Full range of wood-look SPC flooring, 110+ colors

## Product Lines: Wall Panels
